description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into Intercom contacts via search-then-write. Intercom has no single-call native upsert, so this searches /contacts/search by external_id or email, then updates the match or creates a new contact.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Intercom contact (upserted via email/external_id).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_upserted / rows_errored). No downstream data -- write side effect lands in Intercom.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

email_column.label: Email Column
email_column.description: Upstream column holding the contact's email (used as the match key if set).

external_id_column.label: External Id Column
external_id_column.description: Upstream column holding an external_id (used as the match key if set; takes precedence over email).

attributes_map.label: Attributes Map
attributes_map.description: Upstream column -> Intercom CORE contact field (e.g. name, phone).

custom_attributes_map.label: Custom Attributes Map
custom_attributes_map.description: Upstream column -> Intercom custom_attributes key (must already exist in the workspace).

max_rows.label: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Safety cap on total rows per run.

name: Intercom Contact Upsert
